The '''Rishi Hideout''' was type of real estate property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], available on the [[Stronghold directory terminal|Stronghold market]] during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Rishi Hideout is the Rishi stronghold introduced in update 5.9.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]''.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
